scope: author single pinned-runner test; not independent execution

checkout_input_aggregate.selection: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z -- server; retain .go, .sql, /go.mod, /go.sum; de-duplicate and sort paths
checkout_input_aggregate.encoding: UTF-8 concatenation of lines <raw-file-sha256><two spaces><git-path><LF>; SHA-256 of concatenation

limitations: Aggregate excludes external module/cache contents, runtime environment and ignored files. Raw evidence contains sensitive approval rows; do not commit.
